title: Create a simple Blender animation first and use its 3D motion as the guide…
content:
Create a simple Blender animation first and use its 3D motion as the guide input for Seedance 2.0 to control movement.  
Apply a reference image in Seedance 2.0 to transfer its look and add stylized detail onto the guided motion.
